The RFI will be released in Q1/2021 to potential suppliers in Chile to validate technical feasibility and reliability of the potential solutions and possible installation schedule. Based on the outcome, ESO plans to issue the Call for tender in Q2/2021. The scope of work includes the provision of the following key communication services: - High speed direct Internet access at ALMA Central Office (SCO) in Santiago; - Direct Internet access ALMA Operation Support Facility (OSF) near to San Pedro de Atacama; - Access to Public Telephone network (aiming SIP Trunk where feasible) from ALMA sites (SCO, OSF); - Secondary dedicated link between OSF and SCO to allow data transport (science, operations) and IT services (email, Videoconference, etc.). Services will be provided on a “turnkey” basis for every component of the solution, which considers: provision, installation, configuration and testing of the required components, as well as the support service (call center 7x24x365), corrective maintenance (repairs and maintenance of the devices) for each service. The Service Contract shall start on 01.02.2022 after the proper installation and testing period (1 month – starting 01.01.2022) of the required components and shall consider a firm period of 3 years with the option to extend it for 2 more years.
